purpose: Validate faster editing and trustworthy technical plus creative judgement of every video, photo, carousel and platform export. Resolve Studio purchase alone is not QC acceptance.
authorization: Research requested by Nitin; no budget, deploy, publishing, A/B choice or locked grade change authorized.

workstreams.name: COLOR
research: Inspect installed Resolve Studio version, color management, input interpretation, output transforms, levels and tagging; preserve locked grade.
Measure scopes/clipping and reference shot consistency with correct color transforms; do not infer color match from metadata or raw unnormalized RGB.
Compare actual HLG outputs and separately proposed SDR derivatives on controlled reference display and target phone. Browser AI cannot certify calibrated HDR.
Set project-specific tolerances using reference samples, not universal skin-tone brightness targets.

workstreams.name: CAPTIONS
research: Distinguish lyric subtitles, artist/song title graphics and platform post copy.
Check verified text and timing, font availability, duplicate layers, bounding boxes, temporal windows and UI-safe regions.

Combine project preflight with actual-render all-frame checks where feasible, transition inspection and real-size playback. Validate OCR recall on stylized gold fonts and Hindi/Romanized Hindi; abstain on uncertainty.
Evaluate native Fusion/Text+ and Studio animated subtitle workflows for actual installed version and scripting support; speech recognition alone does not establish sung lyric accuracy.

workstreams.name: EDIT_AUDIO
research: Audit all cuts, source ranges, black/freeze events, frame pacing and lip-sync in final output; intentional holds excluded by contract.
Evaluate musical phrase/emotional structure as well as beat alignment; beat detector peaks are not proof of kick/snare identity.
Measure true peaks/loudness/codec effects and source continuity; no locked mix changes without authorization.
Check opening, ending, vocal breathing room, mouth visibility, motion restraint and real export.

workstreams.name: BRAND_ALL_POSTS
research: Small approved motion/typography/logo design system, not per-post redesign.
Photo set: coherent lighting/skin appearance, controlled retouch retaining identity, crops, cover legibility and carousel continuity.
Verify correct thumbnail, aspect ratio, UI-safe text, asset SHA, copy, credits, CTA and target export for each placement.

benchmark.inputs: Read historical defect evidence first; select exact V12/V13/A/B sources only when bytes available and permitted; do not assume any disputed sample is clean.
benchmark.controls: Isolated disposable known-defect variants plus independently verified clean controls; never overwrite masters.
benchmark.method: Separate tuning and held-out examples; blind identity labels while retaining hashes. Human-confirm ground truth where subjective or ambiguous. Measure missed critical defects, false alarms, review time, rework and active editing time versus same baseline.
benchmark.acceptance: All critical known defects in scoped held-out acceptance set must block; no unresolved critical disagreement can yield PASS. This does not prove zero error outside tested scope. Quality/style rubric calibrated to Nitin references and approved only after A/B decision.
benchmark.uncertainty: NOT_VERIFIED/HOLD instead of unsupported PASS; technical pass must not become aesthetic or publishing approval.

roles.work_codex: Inspect capabilities, implement only authorized bounded checks and compare measured workflow times; immutable evidence.
roles.claude: Review template/automation design before benchmark execution via existing context; no unsupported media claims.
roles.gemini: Independent actual-asset timecoded creative/visual findings in existing strategy context; evidence required and contradictions retained.
roles.nitin: Creative standard and final approvals, not routine technical debugging

deliverables: Capability matrix: native feature / scriptable and tested / UI-only / external fallback / unavailable.
Defect benchmark report with detection gaps and false alarms.
Versioned style and QC contract separating hard defects from subjective scores.
One pilot post package with exact export evidence and time comparison.
Prioritized implementation plan by actual time saved; no new subscription assumed.
